product.name: Example hybrid-monetization casual game (示例：混合变现休闲游戏)
product.game_day_boundary: 00:00 local; server reset at 05:00 is a separate content day
product.revenue_basis: net revenue after platform share, channel share, refunds, and tax
product.attribution_window: click 7d, view 1d, self-attributing networks per contract

events.name: ua_install_attributed
events.notes: Partner-owned and restatable. Reconcile against first_launch; never treat as exact.

events.name: ua_spend_daily
events.notes: Daily partner feed, restated for up to 3 days. Snapshot before use in ROAS.

events.name: ad_impression
events.notes: Estimated revenue is restated by networks; client impression counts are reconciled, not summed.

metrics.name: Daily value-realizing players
metrics.question: How many accounts actually get the intended play experience each day, rather than merely opening the app?
metrics.definition: Distinct eligible accounts that complete at least two core loops in a product day. Chosen from the participation distribution, not from a round number.
filters: exclude QA, internal, bot-flagged, and banned accounts
metrics.direction: increase while ad-load and retention guardrails hold
metrics.review_note: Re-derive the loop threshold each quarter; a threshold copied from another title is not a definition.

metrics.name: D1 exact-day retention rate
metrics.question: Do newly acquired accounts come back on the very next day?
metrics.definition: Share of an activation cohort that is active on exactly cohort date + 1. Cohort anchor is first qualifying activation, not install postback. Aggregated as sum(retained) / sum(eligible cohort), never as an average of daily percentages.
metrics.formula: count_distinct(cohort accounts active on day 1) / count_distinct(eligible cohort accounts)
metrics.zero_denominator_policy: Return null when the eligible cohort is 0; never render 0%.
filters: exclude reattributed reinstalls, QA, and bot-flagged accounts
metrics.freshness: daily by 11:00 local, cohort restated for 3 days

benchmark.value: own trailing 8-week median for the same media_source and platform
benchmark.note: Internal comparison baseline only. Do not compare against externally quoted retention numbers whose anchor, aggregation, and acquisition mix are unknown.

metrics.name: Rewarded ad completion rate
metrics.question: Once a player chooses to watch a rewarded ad, does the flow finish and pay out?
metrics.definition: Completed rewarded views divided by started rewarded views. Reward-grant failures are tracked separately because a completed view without a granted reward is a trust incident, not a monetization win.
metrics.formula: count(rewarded views completed) / count(rewarded views started)
metrics.zero_denominator_policy: Return null when started views are 0; suppress the tile rather than showing undefined.
filters: exclude test placements and debug builds
metrics.freshness: hourly, network revenue reconciled next day
metrics.direction: increase; investigate any drop alongside SDK version and network mix

metrics.name: Ad ARPDAU
metrics.question: How much net ad revenue does an average daily active account generate?
metrics.definition: Daily net ad revenue divided by DAU. Decomposed as ad-exposed rate × impressions per exposed account × eCPM / 1000 before any hypothesis is raised.
metrics.formula: net ad revenue for the day / DAU
metrics.monetary_basis: net ad revenue after mediation and platform share, in CNY at the reporting-day FX rate
filters: exclude internal accounts; exclude days with a known mediation reporting incident
metrics.freshness: T+1 by 12:00 local; restated when networks revise revenue
metrics.direction: increase without degrading D1/D7 retention or session length
metrics.restatement_policy: Network revisions are applied to the original day; the dashboard shows the restatement delta.

metrics.name: D7 ROAS
metrics.zh: 7 日广告支出回报（俗称 7 日 ROI）
metrics.question: How much of the media spend on an acquisition cohort has come back within 7 days?
metrics.definition: Cumulative net revenue (IAP plus ad) attributable to an acquisition cohort through day 7, divided by the fully loaded media spend for that cohort. This is ROAS, not ROI: no cost of goods, no operating cost, no discounting is applied.
metrics.formula: cumulative net revenue of the cohort through day 7 / media spend attributed to the cohort
metrics.monetary_basis: net revenue after platform and channel share; spend includes agency fee and tax
metrics.zero_denominator_policy: Return null when cohort spend is 0; organic cohorts are reported separately, not as infinite ROAS.
filters: exclude cohorts whose spend feed has not settled
metrics.freshness: T+1, spend restated for 3 days, revenue restated for 7
metrics.direction: increase; scaling decisions use marginal ROAS at the campaign level, not this average
metrics.known_limits: Attribution-based, so it inherits window, SKAN/privacy truncation, and organic contamination. Incrementality tests, not this metric, answer whether spend caused the revenue.

metrics.name: D30 predicted LTV
metrics.question: What net contribution should we expect from a new cohort by day 30, while it is still too young to measure?
metrics.definition: Projected cumulative net revenue per acquired account through day 30, computed as the sum over days of fitted retention multiplied by observed ARPDAU by tenure. A predicted value, not a realized one.
metrics.formula: sum over t in 1..30 of fitted_retention(t) * arpdau_by_tenure(t)
metrics.monetary_basis: net revenue per acquired account, CNY, cohort-date FX
metrics.estimation_method: Predicted: retention fitted per cohort family on weighted retention excluding day 0, ARPDAU by tenure from the trailing 4 mature cohorts. Backtested on cohorts already past day 30; current MAPE and its by-channel spread are published with the metric. Censoring and the tenure-mix assumption are stated on the dashboard.
metrics.window: cohort date through cohort date + 30, projected
metrics.zero_denominator_policy: Return null when the cohort is smaller than the minimum fit size.
filters: exclude cohorts below the minimum fit size
exclude cohorts spanning a monetization change
metrics.direction: increase; replace with realized D30 LTV as soon as the cohort matures
metrics.known_limits: Long-horizon extrapolation from a power-law tail overestimates. Never present the projection without its backtest error and its replacement date.
